title: TextStyle
description: Represents the styling that can be applied to a TextRun. If this text is contained in a shape with a parent placeholder, then these text styles may be inherited from the parent.

fontFamily.description: The font family of the text.

baselineOffset.description: The text's vertical offset from its normal position.

smallCaps.description: Whether the text is in small capital letters.

strikethrough.description: Whether the text is struck through.
